resources.string: Mix 500g quark, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar, and 3 tbsp flour. Form small patties and fry in oil until golden brown.
Cook a rich broth. Boil noodles separately. Combine broth, noodles, a boiled egg, nori, and pork slices in a bowl.
Brown minced meat with veggies. Top with a layer of mashed potatoes and bake until the top is golden brown.
